FN-8V74HFH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 376
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Ernie Yarbrough
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 376 as introduced could increase the obligations of state and local law enforcement
agencies by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to: 1) comply with certain booking
and intake procedures of illegal aliens and foreign nationals established by this bill; and 2)
publicly report on certain jail data.
Further, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency to post reports of each jail on its website.
This bill could increase the obligations of the Office of Attorney General by requiring the
Attorney General to report violations by officials or agencies to the Governor and Comptroller.
This bill could also decrease potential receipts to state agencies or political subdivisions of the
state by an undetermined amount dependent on any grants, funds, or appropriations withheld
due to violation of this bill.
Finally, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the
Board of Pardons and Paroles, and community corrections programs by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses
provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
